## Finale and restoration continuity

The master boss contract owns all boss health values, phase thresholds, timings, supporting phase-puzzle counts, damage, camera limits, and retry details. This appendix fixes exactly one boss and one final exposed core; it adds no boss adds or auxiliary seal count. Regular arrows may damage the guardian normally until the mandatory 10% HP floor. They can never finish it or push it below that floor. The final core must be exposed and receive a direct hit from an Aurora shot fired by the player; splash, automatic effects, companion actions, environmental hits, reflected damage, or an older power cannot satisfy that final condition.

The guardian communicates the weakness in readable dialogue and a visible core cue before the required shot. It attacks and dodges through fair, telegraphed commitments based on visible encounter state, never by inspecting an unrevealed button press or instantaneous hidden aiming intent. A missed Aurora, interrupted opening, or failed phase puzzle brings the opportunity back. Recharge/recovery and repeatable phase access must prevent permanent failure states; no one-time target or consumed resource may lock the player out of a valid ending.

At redemption, corruption lifts as luminous roots and leaves, the guardian regains its gentle silhouette, and its voice thanks the selected hero without assigning their identity or gender. Luma carries the restored oath back through the visible waterways. Erin's closing journal names the achievement as skill placed in service of living things. The restored meadow, village, lake, and canopy appear in a short playable or skippable vista sequence. Record campaign completion, retain all permanent powers and mastery progress, and leave chapter replay available with restored-state continuity.

Across the campaign, saved restoration should be visible when revisiting completed places: water flows through repaired channels, target mechanisms sit in their functional state, travel routes remain connected, and local light/color reflects the chapter's repair. Replaying a challenge can temporarily reset its targets and explicitly gated encounters, while preserving the world's completed story state. Do not undo a redeemed guardian, relock a permanent power, or claim an optional character was purchased simply because a chapter is replayed.

combat_curriculum.lesson: Dodge the patterns, expose the core, then charge Aurora for the final hit.
